newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, hedges rolled out.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, hedges rolled out.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed in light volume as hedges continued to be rolled out to March amid slow farmer sales, traders said.
"Cash continues to firm up because the farmer's not selling," a trader said. "Naturally the spread's widening as hedgers roll positions out into the March."
Spring wheat saw earlier support from scattered buying by the mills. Traders also cited strength on short covering.
MGE spring wheat closed one cent per bushel lower to four cents higher, with Dec up one cent at $4.20. March lost a cent to settle at $4.15 per bushel.
Traders said Benson Quinn bought one million Dec bushels and sold 500,000 Dec. CIS bought 500,000 Dec and sold 400,000 March. Wilson bull-spread 500,000 Dec/March at three to 3-1/2 cents per bushel.
MGE estimated Wednesday's volume at 19.322 million bushels, versus 20.669 million on Tuesday.
MGE Dec barley futures lost five cents per hundredweight to close at $7.13. March barley settled three cents lower at $7.16.
